description: Agent IP Records: submit trademark and patent application filing records with the filing receipts, docket and exhibits they answer to: the moment the records are read at and the days after filing within which the records say an application advances past filing; each application with its id, reference, kind, title, serial number, the filing receipt it names, the moment filed, its status and the specimens and drawings the filing asserts; each filing receipt on file with its id, reference, serial number and the moment the office issued it; each docket filing entry with its id, the application or its serial number and the filing date the docket records; each specimen or drawing on file with its id, reference, kind and the application it belongs to. The signed report gives the applications and the receipts, each application recorded as filed against its serial number and a filing receipt on file, each filing date against the date the docket records, each application still at filing against the days the records allow, and each asserted specimen or drawing against the records on file, and counts them, and names divergent application filing records: an application recorded as filed with no filing receipt or serial number on file, a filing date that differs between the application record and the docket, an application whose recorded status never advances past filing, and a specimen or drawing asserted in a filing with no record of it on file; then a filing receipt stating another serial number than the application and a docket entry naming an application the records do not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No applications, no filing receipts beside the applications, or an application at filing with no reading moment, filing date or days allowed leaves those points unverified. Applications, receipts, docket entries and exhibits match by letters and digits, an application by its own reference or its serial number, a receipt by the reference the application names or its serial number, dates compare by the day, an application still at filing stalls once more days have passed than the records allow, and an application at any later status has advanced. This reads each filing as the office acknowledged it, from the filing receipt to the first step after filing. Verdict ip_filing_divergent, ip_filing_partial, ip_filing_unverified or ip_filing_consistent. POST /api/ip-filing-check. Reads the intellectual property records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it files no application, pays no fee, contacts no patent or trademark office or attorney and gives no legal advice, which stay with the owner, its IP counsel and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent IP Records reads a business’s own intellectual property records: trademark and patent application records, registration records, prosecution and office-action records, renewal and maintenance records, assignment and chain-of-title records as recorded at the IP office, license records, use and specimen records and docket records, each against the application, registration and docket records, the filing receipts and exhibits on file, the responses and the portfolio, the registrations, the register’s chain of title, the register records, the use records or the matters and filings on record. The family’s ground is the office record behind the brand and the invention: what was applied for, what registered, who the register says owns it, and whether the deadlines and licenses hold up; the Agent Legal family reads the contracts parties sign, and the Agent Tax Records family reads filings made to the tax authority, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-ip-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-ip-records/.
